So this morning, to my surprise, I wanted to create a CursorAI/Project Rule to add the weather forecast to my weekly agenda in Logseq, and was looking for a Good Enough, Quickly pre-made weather MCP server that would quickly work in cursor, and didn't see anything super obvious.

The list of MCP/GitHub/servers either in the src folder or in the root readme (which reads a bit like an AwesomeList) contain one.

llms-txt New standard to look up docs for software in cursor, etc.

tldr llms.txt and llms-full.txt allow large language models (LLMs) and agents to access programming documentation and APIs, particularly useful within integrated development environments (IDEs). As of 2025-03-09 Sun, IDEs do not yet have robust native support for llms.txt, but langchain has an MCP Server LangChain/GitHub/mpcdoc for accessing these files, and they happen to provide them for the LangChain/Ecosystem.
